Optional Local PowerShell Helper

Windows 11 Process Detection Setup & Limits

How local process detection works, why browsers restrict it, and how to run it without lag

Current Watcher Bridge Status: Checking...

Waiting for local `current_game.js` heartbeat file in the same folder as this HTML file.

Desktop App Mode (`NexusCompanion.exe` — Single-Launch WebView2 App)

When launched via `NexusCompanion.exe` (built with `Build-DesktopApp.bat`), this UI runs inside a native Windows 11 desktop window with built-in background game & League LCU detection via WebView2 Bridge—no separate PowerShell console, no `current_game.js` polling, and no local HTTP port required.

  • System Tray & Global Hotkeys: Minimize to tray, toggle Show/Hide (`Ctrl+Alt+G`), toggle Always on Top (`Ctrl+Alt+T`), or switch Compact / Full HUD Mode (`Alt+C`). Hotkeys are available in the desktop app.
  • Fullscreen Exclusive vs. Borderless Windowed Limit: Standard Windows desktop windows cannot render on top of DirectX/Vulkan Fullscreen Exclusive games. To use Always-on-Top overlay mode on a single monitor, set your game to Borderless Windowed, or keep Nexus Companion on a second monitor.
  • Browser storage: Your profiles, custom builds, loadouts and checkboxes are saved in this browser on this device.
Standalone Browser Fallback (`index.html` + `Watch-Games.ps1`)

Web browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave) run inside a strict security sandbox and cannot read your Windows 11 Task Manager directly. To bridge that gap locally without installing extra software:

  • How the bridge works: A built-in Windows PowerShell script (`Watch-Games.ps1`) checks only the 7 game process names (plus Riot Live Client API on 127.0.0.1:2999 for League of Legends champion detection) every 5 seconds and updates a tiny 1-line file named `current_game.js` in the same folder whenever your active game changes.
  • Low-lag optimization: Unlike older scripts that scanned every Windows process and wrote to disk constantly, this script queries only the target game names (`Get-Process -Name ...`) and writes to disk only when a game starts, stops, or refreshes its 15-second heartbeat.
  • Windows permissions: Windows 11 blocks `.ps1` scripts by default unless started with `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` (which `Start-GameWatcher.bat` handles for that single window). Windows SmartScreen may ask you to click "More info → Run anyway" the first time you run a `.bat` file.
  • Browser `file://` restriction note: Opening `index.html` directly via `file://` works in most desktop browsers when `current_game.js` is in the exact same folder, but some strict browser privacy modes block dynamic script reloads on `file://`. If the status above says Blocked / Unreachable, you can switch games manually in the left sidebar or use the Test Mode dropdown.
Step 1: `Watch-Games.ps1` (Save in the same folder as `index.html`)

Includes `WardogsClient-Win64-Shipping` and `WARDOGS-Win64-Shipping` for WARDOGS alongside League of Legends (with Live Client Champion Detection) and the other 5 games. 

# Windows 11 Game Companion Watcher (BelowNormal Priority + Scoped Loopback Cert Policy + Riot Live Client & LCU Bench Detector)
try {
  [System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().PriorityClass = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessPriorityClass]::BelowNormal
} catch {
  Write-Warning ("Could not set BelowNormal process priority: " + $_.Exception.Message)
}

$targets = [ordered]@{
  "Cyberpunk2077"                             = "cp2077"
  "Warhammer 40000 Space Marine 2 - Retail"   = "sm2"
  "SpaceMarine2"                              = "sm2"
  "WardogsClient-Win64-Shipping"              = "wardogs"
  "WARDOGS-Win64-Shipping"                    = "wardogs"
  "WARDOGS"                                   = "wardogs"
  "Darktide"                                  = "darktide"
  "helldivers2"                               = "helldivers2"
  "RainbowSix"                                = "r6s"
  "RainbowSix_Vulkan"                         = "r6s"
  "RainbowSix_DX11"                           = "r6s"
  "League of Legends"                         = "lol"
  "LeagueClientUx"                            = "lol"
}
$targetNames = [string[]]$targets.Keys
$outFile = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "current_game.js"

# Scoped certificate policy: ONLY accepts self-signed certs for 127.0.0.1 on Riot Live Client port 2999 or active LCU port
try {
  Add-Type @"
using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
public class RiotLoopbackCertPolicy : ICertificatePolicy {
    public static int AllowedLcuPort = -1;
    public bool CheckValidationResult(ServicePoint srvPoint, X509Certificate certificate, WebRequest request, int certificateProblem) {
        if (request != null && request.RequestUri != null) {
            string h = request.RequestUri.Host;
            int p = request.RequestUri.Port;
            if (h == "127.0.0.1" && (p == 2999 || (AllowedLcuPort > 0 && p == AllowedLcuPort))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return certificateProblem == 0;
    }
}
"@
  [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::CertificatePolicy = New-Object RiotLoopbackCertPolicy
} catch {
  Write-Warning ("RiotLoopbackCertPolicy Add-Type warning: " + $_.Exception.Message)
}

$champMap = @{
  1="Annie"; 2="Olaf"; 3="Galio"; 4="Twisted Fate"; 5="Xin Zhao"; 6="Urgot"; 7="LeBlanc"; 8="Vladimir"; 9="Fiddlesticks"; 10="Kayle";
  11="Master Yi"; 12="Alistar"; 13="Ryze"; 14="Sion"; 15="Sivir"; 16="Soraka"; 17="Teemo"; 18="Tristana"; 19="Warwick"; 20="Nunu & Willump";
  21="Miss Fortune"; 22="Ashe"; 23="Tryndamere"; 24="Jax"; 25="Morgana"; 26="Zilean"; 27="Singed"; 28="Evelynn"; 29="Twitch"; 30="Karthus";
  31="Cho'Gath"; 32="Amumu"; 33="Rammus"; 34="Anivia"; 35="Shaco"; 36="Dr. Mundo"; 37="Sona"; 38="Kassadin"; 39="Irelia"; 40="Janna";
  41="Gangplank"; 42="Corki"; 43="Karma"; 44="Taric"; 45="Veigar"; 48="Trundle"; 50="Swain"; 51="Caitlyn"; 53="Blitzcrank"; 54="Malphite";
  55="Katarina"; 56="Nocturne"; 57="Maokai"; 58="Renekton"; 59="Jarvan IV"; 60="Elise"; 61="Orianna"; 62="Wukong"; 63="Brand"; 64="Lee Sin";
  67="Vayne"; 68="Rumble"; 69="Cassiopeia"; 72="Skarner"; 74="Heimerdinger"; 75="Nasus"; 76="Nidalee"; 77="Udyr"; 78="Poppy"; 79="Gragas";
  80="Pantheon"; 81="Ezreal"; 82="Mordekaiser"; 83="Yorick"; 84="Akali"; 85="Kennen"; 86="Garen"; 89="Leona"; 90="Malzahar"; 91="Talon";
  92="Riven"; 96="Kog'Maw"; 98="Shen"; 99="Lux"; 101="Xerath"; 102="Shyvana"; 103="Ahri"; 104="Graves"; 105="Fizz"; 106="Volibear";
  107="Rengar"; 110="Varus"; 111="Nautilus"; 112="Viktor"; 113="Sejuani"; 114="Fiora"; 115="Ziggs"; 117="Lulu"; 119="Draven"; 120="Hecarim";
  121="Kha'Zix"; 122="Darius"; 126="Jayce"; 127="Lissandra"; 131="Diana"; 133="Quinn"; 134="Syndra"; 136="Aurelion Sol"; 141="Kayn"; 142="Zoe";
  143="Zyra"; 145="Kai'Sa"; 147="Seraphine"; 150="Gnar"; 154="Zac"; 157="Yasuo"; 161="Vel'Koz"; 163="Taliyah"; 164="Camille"; 166="Akshan";
  200="Bel'Veth"; 201="Braum"; 202="Jhin"; 203="Kindred"; 221="Zeri"; 222="Jinx"; 223="Tahm Kench"; 234="Viego"; 235="Senna"; 236="Lucian";
  238="Zed"; 240="Kled"; 245="Ekko"; 246="Qiyana"; 254="Vi"; 266="Aatrox"; 267="Nami"; 268="Azir"; 350="Yuumi"; 360="Samira";
  412="Thresh"; 420="Illaoi"; 421="Rek'Sai"; 427="Ivern"; 429="Kalista"; 432="Bard"; 497="Rakan"; 498="Xayah"; 516="Ornn"; 517="Sylas";
  518="Neeko"; 523="Aphelios"; 526="Rell"; 555="Pyke"; 711="Vex"; 777="Yone"; 875="Sett"; 876="Lillia"; 887="Gwen"; 888="Renata Glasc";
  895="Nilah"; 897="K'Sante"; 901="Smolder"; 902="Milio"; 910="Hwei"; 950="Naafiri"; 893="Aurora"; 799="Ambessa"
}

$lastStateKey = ""
$lastWriteTime = [DateTimeOffset]::MinValue

Write-Host "Nexus Windows 11 Game Watcher active (BelowNormal CPU priority). Writing to $outFile ..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
while ($true) {
  $foundId = ""
  $foundExe = ""
  $foundChamp = ""
  $foundPhase = ""
  $benchList = @()

  $runningProcs = Get-Process -Name $targetNames -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($runningProcs) {
    $runningNames = @($runningProcs | ForEach-Object { $_.ProcessName })
    foreach ($procName in $targetNames) {
      if ($runningNames -contains $procName) {
        $foundId = $targets[$procName]
        $foundExe = "$procName.exe"
        break
      }
    }

    if ($foundId -eq "lol") {
      # 1. Query Live Client API (127.0.0.1:2999) ONLY while League of Legends.exe is running
      if ($runningNames -contains "League of Legends") {
        try {
          $liveData = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://127.0.0.1:2999/liveclientdata/allgamedata" -TimeoutSec 1 -ErrorAction Stop
          if ($liveData -and $liveData.activePlayer -and $liveData.allPlayers) {
            $activeName = $liveData.activePlayer.summonerName
            $riotId = $liveData.activePlayer.riotIdGameName
            foreach ($p in $liveData.allPlayers) {
              if (($p.summonerName -eq $activeName) -or ($riotId -and $p.riotIdGameName -eq $riotId)) {
                $foundChamp = $p.championName
                $foundPhase = "in_game"
                break
              }
            }
            if (-not $foundChamp -and $liveData.allPlayers.Count -gt 0) {
              $foundChamp = $liveData.allPlayers[0].championName
              $foundPhase = "in_game"
            }
          }
        } catch { }
      }

      # 2. Query LCU Champ Select ONLY while LeagueClientUx.exe is running and not already in_game
      if (-not $foundChamp -and ($runningNames -contains "LeagueClientUx")) {
        try {
          $lcuProc = $runningProcs | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -eq "LeagueClientUx" } | Select-Object -First 1
          if ($lcuProc -and $lcuProc.Path) {
            $lcuDir = Split-Path -Parent $lcuProc.Path
            $lockPath = Join-Path $lcuDir "lockfile"
            if (Test-Path $lockPath) {
              # Read lockfile password, build 127.0.0.1 header from computed $authB64, and clear variable references after request
              $rawLock = Get-Content $lockPath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
              $parts = $rawLock.Split(":")
              if ($parts.Length -ge 4) {
                $lcuPort = [int]$parts[2]
                $lcuPass = $parts[3]
                [RiotLoopbackCertPolicy]::AllowedLcuPort = $lcuPort
                $authB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes("riot:$lcuPass"))
                $authPrefix = "Basic"
                $authHeaderVal = ($authPrefix, $authB64) -join " "
                $headers = @{ Authorization = $authHeaderVal }
                $session = $null
                try {
                  $session = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://127.0.0.1:$lcuPort/lol-champ-select/v1/session" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 1 -ErrorAction Stop
                } finally {
                  $rawLock = $null
                  $parts = $null
                  $lcuPass = $null
                  $authB64 = $null
                  $authPrefix = $null
                  $authHeaderVal = $null
                  $headers = $null
                }
                if ($session) {
                  $foundPhase = "champ_select"
                  $cellId = $session.localPlayerCellId
                  foreach ($p in $session.myTeam) {
                    if ($p.cellId -eq $cellId -and $p.championId -gt 0) {
                      $cid = [int]$p.championId
                      if ($champMap.ContainsKey($cid)) { $foundChamp = $champMap[$cid] }
                    }
                  }
                  if ($session.benchChampions) {
                    foreach ($b in $session.benchChampions) {
                      $bid = [int]$b.championId
                      if ($bid -gt 0) {
                        $bName = if ($champMap.ContainsKey($bid)) { $champMap[$bid] } else { "$bid" }
                        $benchList += $bName
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } catch {
          # Suppress error output so request headers or lockfile credentials are never logged
        }
      }

      if (-not $foundPhase -and ($runningNames -notcontains "League of Legends")) {
        $foundPhase = "client_open"
      }
    }
  }

  $benchJoined = ($benchList -join ",")
  $stateKey = "$foundId|$foundChamp|$foundPhase|$benchJoined"
  $now = [DateTimeOffset]::Now
  if (($stateKey -ne $lastStateKey) -or (($now - $lastWriteTime).TotalSeconds -ge 10)) {
    $ts = $now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    # Escape backslashes BEFORE single quotes when building current_game.js
    $safeId = ([string]$foundId).Replace('\', '\\').Replace("'", "\'")
    $safeExe = ([string]$foundExe).Replace('\', '\\').Replace("'", "\'")
    $safeChamp = ([string]$foundChamp).Replace('\', '\\').Replace("'", "\'")
    $safePhase = ([string]$foundPhase).Replace('\', '\\').Replace("'", "\'")
    $benchJson = if ($benchList.Count -gt 0) { "[" + (($benchList | ForEach-Object { "'" + ([string]$_).Replace('\', '\\').Replace("'", "\'") + "'" }) -join ",") + "]" } else { "[]" }
    $js = "window.__WIN11_ACTIVE_GAME__ = { gameId: '$safeId', exe: '$safeExe', champion: '$safeChamp', phase: '$safePhase', benchChampions: $benchJson, timestamp: $ts };"
    Set-Content -Path $outFile -Value $js -Encoding UTF8
    $lastStateKey = $stateKey
    $lastWriteTime = $now
  }
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
}
Step 2: Optional `Start-GameWatcher.bat` Launcher (Save in the same folder)
@echo off
title Nexus Gaming Companion - Windows 11 Low-CPU Game Watcher
REM Note: -ExecutionPolicy Bypass is scoped strictly to this single child PowerShell process and does not change your Windows system policy.
REM Pass --hidden (or run Start-GameWatcher.bat --hidden) to run the watcher with a hidden console window (-WindowStyle Hidden).
start "" "%~dp0index.html"
if /I "%~1"=="--hidden" (
  powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0Watch-Games.ps1"
  exit /b 0
)
echo ================================================================
echo   NEXUS COMPANION - WINDOWS 11 LIVE GAME DETECTOR (LOW-CPU)
echo   Tip: Run "Start-GameWatcher.bat --hidden" for a hidden window.
echo   Note: -ExecutionPolicy Bypass applies only to this process.
echo   Keep this window minimized while gaming. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
echo ================================================================
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0Watch-Games.ps1"

Plain-English Coding & App Glossary

Everything inside this project explained simply and accurately

HTML (`index.html`) & Offline Mode: The structure and code of the app live inside this single file so you can open it without a web server. All layout utilities, Codex / Classic Tactical looks, and system font stacks are 100% embedded inside this file—it makes zero external CDN or Google Fonts requests whether online or offline.
JavaScript Object (`DEFAULT_GAME_DATA`): A structured digital notebook inside the code that stores your games, builds, loadouts, and economy tips using simple labels like `name` and `description`.
LocalStorage (Browser-Profile Memory): Built-in storage inside the specific web browser and profile you use (e.g., Edge or Chrome). Clearing browser site data or switching browsers won't carry changes over automatically—use Export JSON and Import JSON to save a backup file.
Process (`.exe`) & Test Mode: The program name Windows 11 shows in Task Manager when a game runs (like `WardogsClient-Win64-Shipping.exe`). The Test Mode dropdown in the top bar only simulates switching inside the UI—real detection requires running `Watch-Games.ps1` on Windows 11.

What's new: November 2026

Highlights

  • Helldivers 2 War Room. Live war status on the Helldivers 2 page: the current Major Order with a countdown, a galaxy map, the active fronts with Helldiver counts, High Command dispatches, a starting kit for each enemy, and a 30-second stratagem typing drill. It needs an internet connection and refreshes every minute while it is open.
  • Build Labs. Craft your own build instead of copying one. Pick a start, move points or swap items, and watch the charts change.
    • Cyberpunk 2077: attributes, perks, a damage estimate and a power curve by level.
    • Helldivers 2: loadout builder with cooldowns, weapon stats and gear text read from the wiki.
    • Rainbow Six Siege: five-operator squad builder with roles, health and speed ratings from the wiki.
    • Witcher 3: skill-point planner with each level's effect and prerequisites from the wiki.
    • Space Marine 2 and Darktide: class composers built from guide text, marked unchecked.
  • Nexus Recommended builds for Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5: Headshot Gunslinger, Revolver Executioner, Ricochet Storm and Gorilla Arms Juggernaut (shotguns and LMGs).
  • Level 1 to 60 planner for all four recommended builds, in a bar right under the Cyberpunk page tabs.

Also new

  • Patch badges show what changed in the latest patch.
  • A confidence meter shows how fresh and well sourced each build is.
  • Compare two builds side by side in plain language.
  • Checklist mode: tick off each step of a build.
  • Works on phones and tablets, and now has a credits and licences page.

Honesty labels

  • Numbers read from a wiki are marked as verified, with a link and the date they were read.
  • Estimates are marked as estimates. In the Cyberpunk lab only three effects use documented numbers.
  • Space Marine 2 and Darktide labs say they are unchecked.

Fixes

  • A saved lab pick that no longer exists no longer breaks that lab.
  • Loading a preset in the Cyberpunk lab no longer wipes your build. An Undo button brings it back.
  • Pop-up windows take keyboard focus, and focus returns when they close.
  • Buttons keep keyboard focus after each click.
  • The League of Legends tabs no longer push the page sideways on a phone.

Known limits

  • Darktide builds are being reviewed for the latest hotfix.
  • A few skill names in the Witcher builds differ from the wiki's list.
  • Some Rainbow Six operators have no role listed on the wiki, so the coverage chart cannot count them.
  • League of Legends and Wardogs have no lab yet.
  • The War Room reads a community-run service that can be slow or offline. The window then says so and keeps the last data it had.

Credits and licences

Nexus Game Companion is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED, Arrowhead Game Studios, Ubisoft, Saber Interactive, Focus Entertainment, Fatshark, Riot Games, Bulkhead or any other game company. Game names and trademarks belong to their owners.

It is free and non-commercial. It has no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Your profile, builds and checklists stay in this browser on this device. The only outside request the page makes is the live data request for the Helldivers 2 War Room, sent when you view the Helldivers 2 page or open the War Room. That service sees it the way any website sees a visit.

Where the data comes from

  • Helldivers 2 lab: text and numbers adapted from the Helldivers Wiki, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Trimmed and reformatted.
  • Rainbow Six Siege lab: operator facts adapted from the Rainbow Six Wiki on Fandom, licensed CC BY-SA. Trimmed and reformatted.
  • Witcher 3 lab: skill text adapted from the Witcher Wiki on Fandom, licensed CC BY-SA. Trimmed and reformatted.
  • League of Legends ARAM Mayhem: tiers and augment data from arammayhem.com open data, CC BY 4.0.
  • Helldivers 2 War Room (live status): loaded from the community-run Helldivers API. It is not run by the game's developer. Stratagem codes and kit names come from the wiki above.
  • Builds and guides: written in original wording from community guides and official patch notes. The sources are listed on each game page.

Accuracy

Nothing here has been tested in the game unless it says so. Games change often, so check the in-game text before you rely on a number. Space Marine 2 and Darktide labs come from guide text only and are marked unchecked.
